subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw doctor --fix 4-5x slower on 2026.5.20 vs 2026.5.19 (55s → 229s+) — session snapshot path traversal bottleneck

question: Should maintainers repair PR #85670, replace it with a narrower dependency-safe optimization, or close this issue only after current-main live timing proof shows the slowdown is gone?
rationale: The issue has a merged partial fix, an open blocked candidate PR, and compatibility-sensitive repair sequencing that automation should not resolve without owner direction.

options.title: Repair #85670
options.body: Keep the active candidate but require auth sidecar cleanup order to remain safe and add real before/after doctor timing proof before merge.

options.title: Replace With Narrower PR
options.body: Close or pause #85670 and implement only measured independent optimizations that cannot reorder auth/plugin migrations.

options.title: Close After Live Non-Repro
options.body: Run a current-main upgrade-style doctor repro on the affected class of install and close only if timings and warning behavior are normal without more code.

recommendation.title: Repair #85670
recommendation.body: Keep the active candidate but require auth sidecar cleanup order to remain safe and add real before/after doctor timing proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent doctor/auth repair work and merge activity make this the best available owner for the sequencing and release-readiness call.
